questions.q: Extend: Draw your own hill with five contour lines, steep on one side and gentle on the other.
questions.a: Lines close on one side, far apart on the other

questions.a: A route crossing contours where they are far apart

questions.q: Contour lines very close together show:
questions.a: B) A steep slope. The height changes quickly over a short distance, so it is steep.
